subject: What should be easy isn't:  initiator groups and volume

messages.subject: What should be easy isn't:  initiator groups and volume
parts:
When I first used Nimble I just assumed, Create multiple initiator groups  and link one or more to a volume. Well I couldn't get that to work. So I put same hosts in multiple initiator groups and did one-to-one initiator-grp to volume mappings.
But now that I'm trying to setup Nimble Peer persistence this configuration seems invalid.
How do I configure the 'Nimble way' to achieve what  I need?
Note my environment is VMware. When I add a second initiator group to a volume it assigns a different LUN. VMware didn't work with the added LUN.
Thanks, ===SteveH
